title: perf(canary): adaptive auto-detection + hysteresis rollout guards for latency regressions
author: Arielle Moreno
release_notes: Enhances perf canary detection: adaptive thresholds, hysteresis to avoid flapping, and an automated rollout guard that prevents unsafe traffic shifts on transient latency spikes.
description:
Motivation:
We see a number of noisy latency spikes in production canaries that trigger premature rollouts or rollbacks. This PR improves the canary detector by introducing adaptive thresholding based on recent distribution statistics and a hysteresis window to avoid flapping. It also introduces an automatic rollout guard that pauses traffic shifts when a short-lived regression is detected but resolves afterward, and adds additional observability for KV cache eviction impact.

Summary of changes:
- Adaptive detector algorithm (perf/canary/detector.py): uses rolling percentiles and EWMA to compute dynamic latency/throughput thresholds per model/route.
- Hysteresis policy (perf/canary/hysteresis.py): ensures a candidate must exceed regression thresholds for N consecutive evaluation windows before rollback and must be below recovery thresholds for M windows before resuming traffic shift.
- Rollout guard config (infra/deploy/canary-rollout-policy.yaml): new policy flags (pause_on_spike, max_consecutive_windows, min_recovery_windows).
- KV cache eviction metric and alert hook (metrics/kv_cache_eviction.metricviz): detect when eviction rate correlates with latency shifts.
- Integration tests (tests/perf/test_detector_integration.py) and a sample canary config (examples/perf/canary-configs/sample_canary.json).
- CI script to run canary checks in PR pipelines (scripts/ci/run_canary_checks.sh).

Checklist:
- [x] Unit tests for detector and hysteresis logic
- [x] Integration test that simulates transient spike and ensures no unsafe rollout
- [x] Docs update for canary config and rollout guard (docs/perf/canary.md)
- [x] Observability dashboards updated to show eviction -> latency correlations

Testing notes:
Local unit tests: all pass. Integration: added synthetic workload generator that produces short spikes; verified the rollouts are paused and require sustained regressions to rollback. Ran against staging canary harness for three model types (chat, generation, embeddings) to ensure thresholds adapt per workload profile.

Rollout plan:
- Merge to main behind feature flag perf.canary.adaptive_hysteresis (default off).
- Gradual enablement: enable for 10% of canaries for 24h, monitor eviction/latency charts and the new "canary.guard.paused_count" metric.
- If stable, increase to 50% then 100% over a week.

Risks & mitigations:
- Overly aggressive hysteresis could delay valid rollbacks: default windows are conservative (3 evaluation windows) and can be tuned via config.
- Adaptive thresholds may under-react to sudden platform changes: detector fallbacks to absolute thresholds when volatility exceeds configured bounds.

Related work:
- ENG-1932: canary SLO tuning pilot
- ENG-1987: KV cache eviction telemetry improvements
